card.title: Specification source URL
card.gatewayNote: Checking the URL never changes the gateway. Only "Use this version" does, and then the API resyncs.
card.notConfigured: This API does not watch a URL. Watch one to be told when its OpenAPI document changes.
card.failures: {count, plural, one {# failed check in a row} other {# failed checks in a row}}
card.loadError: The source could not be loaded

sheet.description: The server downloads the document on a schedule and tells you when it changes. Nothing is applied until you review it.
sheet.urlHelp: http or https. For a protected document, put the access token in the query string: user name and password in the URL (Basic auth) are not supported.
sheet.urlKeepHelp: Stored URL: {url}. Leave empty to keep it.
sheet.enabledHelp: Off: only "Check now" downloads the document.

remove.confirmBody: The URL is deleted and a version waiting for review is no longer proposed. The stored specification and the gateway do not change.

check.changedToast: A new version was detected. Review it before it is used.

url.tooLong: The URL can have at most 2048 characters
url.invalid: This is not a valid URL
url.scheme: Use an http or https URL
url.userinfo: User name and password in the URL are not supported. Put the access token in the query string instead.

errors.BAD_URL: The URL is not valid or not allowed (http or https only, no user name or password, at most 2048 characters).
errors.BLOCKED_TARGET: This address cannot be reached from the server, or it is not allowed. Internal addresses need the operator's allow-list.
errors.UNREACHABLE: The server could not connect to this address.
errors.TIMEOUT: The document did not arrive within 10 seconds.
errors.TOO_LARGE: The document is larger than 5 MB.
errors.TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS: The URL redirects more than 3 times.
errors.HTTP: The URL answered with HTTP status {status}.
errors.NOT_A_SPEC: The URL did not serve a valid OpenAPI 3 document.
errors.unknown: The document could not be downloaded.
errors.SPEC_CHECK_COOLDOWN: This URL was checked less than 30 seconds ago. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.SPEC_VERSION_STALE: The specification changed since you opened this review. The comparison has been recomputed: review it again.
errors.SPEC_REMOVES_GOVERNED_ENDPOINTS: This version removes endpoints that have settings, and that changed since you reviewed. The comparison has been recomputed: review it again.
errors.SPEC_GOVERNANCE_CHANGED: Endpoint settings changed since you reviewed. The comparison has been recomputed: review it again.
errors.CANDIDATE_STALE: This version is no longer proposed: it was used, dismissed or replaced. Check the URL again for the latest one.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.notFound: This API or this version no longer exists.
errors.saveFailed: The source could not be saved
errors.removeFailed: The source could not be removed
errors.checkFailed: The URL could not be checked
errors.applyFailed: The version could not be used
errors.dismissFailed: The version could not be dismissed
errors.diffFailed: The comparison could not be loaded
errors.SPEC_SOURCE_LIMIT: This workspace already watches the maximum of 50 specification URLs. Remove one before adding another.
errors.SPEC_SOURCE_URL_REQUIRED: Enter the document URL: no URL is stored for this API yet.
errors.OAS_LINT_FAILED: The document the URL serves has errors, so it cannot be used. Fix the document at its source.
errors.OAS_IMPORT_TOO_MANY_ENDPOINTS: The document the URL serves declares more endpoints than the gateway can manage.
errors.OAS_IMPORT_UNPARSEABLE: The URL did not serve readable JSON or YAML.
errors.OAS_IMPORT_UNSAFE_YAML: The document the URL serves uses YAML features that are refused for safety (such as too many aliases).
errors.OAS_IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: The document the URL serves is not OpenAPI 3.x.
errors.OAS_IMPORT_UNUSABLE: The document the URL serves cannot be used to create or update an API.
errors.CHECK_FAILED: The check could not be completed. It will be retried.
errors.SPEC_SOURCE_CHANGED: The source was changed while it was being checked. Check again.

banner.title: A new version of the specification is available
banner.governed: {removed, plural, =0 {} one {# endpoint with settings removed. } other {# endpoints with settings removed. }}{changed, plural, =0 {} one {# endpoint with settings changed.} other {# endpoints with settings changed.}}
banner.detected: Detected {date}. These counts are from detection; the review compares with the current specification.

review.title: Review the new version
review.description: Compared with the current specification (version {version}). Using it creates the next version and resyncs the API with the gateway.
review.gone: This version is no longer proposed: it was used, dismissed or replaced.
review.dismissHelp: Dismissed content is not proposed again; a different change is.
review.readOnly: Using or dismissing a version needs the api:update permission.
review.alreadyCurrent: This content is already the current specification. Nothing changed and the API does not resync.

dashboard.title: Specs with updates
dashboard.empty: Every watched specification is up to date.
dashboard.governed: {count, plural, one {# endpoint with settings affected} other {# endpoints with settings affected}}

import.urlHelp: The server downloads the document (http or https, up to 5 MB) and checks it. User name and password in the URL are not supported; put an access token in the query string.
import.watchHelp: You are told when the document changes. Nothing changes on the gateway until you review and use a new version.
import.refetchNote: The URL is fetched again when you import, and the same checks run on what it serves then.
